python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('dvc.repo.metrics.show')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'dvc/repo/metrics/show.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import os, subprocess, tempfile
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', tmp], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', tmp, 'config', 'user.email', 't@t'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', tmp, 'config', 'user.name', 't'], check=True)
from dvc.repo import Repo
repo = Repo.init(tmp, no_scm=False)
sub = os.path.join(tmp, 'sub')
os.makedirs(sub)
open(os.path.join(tmp, 'm.yaml'), 'w').write('foo: 1\n')
from dvc.repo.metrics.show import _read_metrics
cwd = os.getcwd()
os.chdir(sub)
try:
    res_sub = _read_metrics(repo, ['m.yaml'], 'workspace')
finally:
    os.chdir(cwd)
os.chdir(tmp)
try:
    res_root = _read_metrics(repo, ['m.yaml'], 'workspace')
finally:
    os.chdir(cwd)
print('metrics_sequence', [res_sub, res_root])
assert len(res_sub) == 1 and list(res_sub.values())[0] == {'data': {'foo': 1}}, res_sub
assert len(res_root) == 1 and list(res_root.values())[0] == {'data': {'foo': 1}}, res_root
